title: Shocked Cat Monday Meme
tests: Tests exact top-and-bottom meme text, correct ordering, and legibility without obscuring the subject.

judge.summary: The square meme has the correct bold, outlined captions and retains the shocked cat and sofa with both eyes unobstructed.

must_haves.item: The top text reads exactly 'WHEN YOU THINK IT'S FRIDAY', with no full stop.
must_haves.why: The top caption reads correctly and has no full stop.

must_haves.item: The bottom text reads exactly 'BUT IT'S ONLY MONDAY', with no full stop.
must_haves.why: The bottom caption reads correctly and has no full stop.

must_haves.item: Both text blocks use large white uppercase letters with visible black outlines and fit entirely within the image.
must_haves.why: Both captions are large, white, uppercase, clearly outlined in black, and fully contained within the frame.

must_haves.item: The same shocked cat and sofa are retained, and neither eye is covered by text.
must_haves.why: The original cat and sofa remain recognizable and both eyes are completely clear of the captions.
The output has equal width and height.
